notes.title: Doodle God Universe: Speedrun Challenge
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40928613/e58cee7ebb3f4594869089c1a5e3d8766663e20f.png
🎮 To spice things up - we are launching a Doodle SpeedRun Challenge on our Discord

⏳Record how you start and finish our Demo as fast as you can and win Doodle God Universe key (pre-order list) 

🏆 Prizes: 

🥇 5 players, who finished the game with the fastest time will get Doodle God Universe Steam key (pre-order list) 
🎁 All other players, who made a recording, finished the game, but the time was out of top-5 - will be randomly drawn into 5 winners of Doodle God Universe Steam keys (pre-order list) 
❕ Everyone who will have valid entries - will get a role "Doodle SpeedRunner" on our Discord server!

❓ How to participate:

👉🏻 Record your gameplay from "Start to Finish" with no editing.
👉🏻 You need to set a visible timer on a screen (download any timer, we recommend the timer for speedrunners: Livesplit).
👉🏻 The whole game screen must be shown, especially the timer.
👉🏻 What is considered "Start to Finish"? Timer START is considered, when you start from "Open the group" screen in the main game (Evolution) . Timer FINISH is considered, when you found 54 elements in the Evolution game and saw the "Thank you for playing screen", AND when you finished the Sea Evolution (Fish) game, after what you saw a "Thank you for playing screen". 
IMPORTANT NOTE: In order to finish the challenge, you MUST create elements "Life", "Fish", "Dolphin" and "Whale". You will not be able to finish the Sea Evolution without these elements and complete this challenge. 
❕ Just to be completely clear: to finish the challenge, you need to finish BOTH Evolution game AND Sea Evolution game. 
👉🏻 Post that recording on YouTube (it can be kept public or unlisted)
👉🏻 Post the link on our Discord, in #fest-speedrun 

‼️ Rules:

1️⃣ You can submit your entries until October 9, 10.00 CET
2️⃣ Cheating is bad 👀 
3️⃣ Rules can change anytime, in case of new circumstances
4️⃣ You need to fully comply with the "Start to Finish" rules to have a valid entry
5️⃣ Well.. Have fun!

‼️ In case you already played the demo, and want to start from the beginning - you just need to delete Doodle God Universe Demo folder on your PC.

❓ How to do that:
%userprofile%\appdata\locallow\joybits

✅ Folder should be there - just delete it and start the game 🙂

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40928613/921fabfb666f022cf922f0fe7743b5ff4883faca.png

💥 Guess who is participating? 😎 Exactly

🤔 And what it means for you, young Creator?
👉 Daily Giveaways on Discord
👉 Doodle God Universe Demo: Speedrun Challenge
👉 Special JoyBits Challenge
👉 Q&A Session with JoyBits
👉 Doodle God Universe: Streams & Media
👉 Doodle Lite Special Event (emojis guessing)
👉 Many other Activities!

🏆 Fest Prize Pool:
Up to 100 different Doodle keys, including up to 30❕Doodle God Universe Steam keys (pre-order list)
If you win Doodle God Universe Steam key (pre-order list) - we will put you into the pre-order list. As soon as the game is out - you will get the key for free!

👀 All of that is happening on our Discord!
👉 Join the fun: https://discord.gg/yQh3n8Rr8M

⌛ Fest Dates:
💚 Start: Monday, October 3, 2022 10am PDT (UTC-7)

notes.title: Doodle God Universe Playtest
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40928613/6ab2fcbf881f231facee78ee8faf0e2993bbaa11.jpg
🔼 Major Announcement 🔼 

🤩 Creators! 

🔥 We are finally ready to announce Doodle God Universe Playtest on Steam!

📄 Feel free to request the access on our page:
👉 https://bit.ly/3woNfWu 👈 

🔶 For now, Playtest is with limited access, which means that we manually approve the number of applications. 

✅ You will be notified when you get the access!

❕ We kindly ask all play-testers to fill out an in-game feedback survey! This will help us to improve the game before the final release on Steam.
By filling out the form you will get the role @Doodle Tester on our Discord server, as well as 2000 Doodlers in Doodle-shop!

🤗 Also leave your feedback and discuss Doodle God Universe here, again, it would help us a lot!
